item.title: Furimuite Cool Eye's
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Parade
  • 発売日: 2001-09-14
  • スコア: 5.85/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 振り向いてCOOL Eye’S
  • 英語名: Furimuite Cool Eye’s

あらすじ

School manga research club is in pinch! It only has three members and will have to disband unless two more members are found within a month. Main character should also recruit only among the girls in order not to repeat last year’s mistake when a lot of people had to quit the club due to romantic problems. Is it possible to save the club?
